data_kind: Original measured service timings and process counters on the assigned LinuxONE VM
model: IsolationForest, 100 trees, 30 baseline observations; 95th-percentile fit-only cutoff
scope: Bounded localhost hash-computation microservice. Pressure annotation identifies actual increased computation, not a production failure or hospital outage. No synthetic pool/retry values are added. This separate novelty experiment does not validate or replace the simulator-trained 60-second breach model.
limitations: Single short experiment on one VM
Only four actual requests per measurement window; p95 is descriptive
Baseline fit is small and noise/resource contention may affect scores
No real disruption, incident recall, causal prevention or cross-domain claim
